checks.name: scripted_passes_v0
checks.observed: core 20/20, memory 10/10, complies 7/7, refusal 8/8, cycle 0.000, trunc 0.000

limitations: Word-level content tokenization plus a fixed stopword list; BPE is reused only for surface length and truncation accounting.
on_topic is a proxy: a fluent but tangential answer can fail it, and a degenerate echo of topic words can pass a row.
refusal_ok detects only a question mark or a declared cue and the absence of declared forbidden facts; it cannot detect an invented fact outside that list.
C1 retrieval passes the refusal threshold (6/8) because neighbours share clarification forms; it still fails v0 overall.
The degenerate control is a raw-continuation artifact scored on chat prompts; its failure is expected and is not evidence about chat-tuned models.
Fresh rows were not opened; no final held-out evaluation was run.
